data.desc: Apple Hospitality REIT, Inc. (NYSE: APLE) is a publicly traded real estate investment trust ('REIT') that owns one of the largest and most diverse portfolios of upscale, rooms-focused hotels in the United States. Apple Hospitality's portfolio consists of 213 hotels with approximately 29,200 guest rooms located in 83 markets throughout 37 states and the District of Columbia. Concentrated with industry-leading brands, the Company's hotel portfolio consists of 113 Hilton-branded hotels, 94 Marriott-branded hotels, five Hyatt-branded hotels and one independent hotel.
